eps.t: The Wind Makes It Too Hard to Hear
eps.ov: Two old friends go to spy on a new table tennis champ at a rival high school, but meanwhile their own team is falling apart.
eps.oa: صديقان قديمان يذهبان ليتجسسا على بطل جديد في تنس الطاولة في ثانوية منافسة، وفريقهما في الأثناء يتفكك.

eps.ov: Coach Koizumi has started working Smile hard, and he definitely doesn't appreciate the extra attention.
eps.oa: بدأ المدرب «كويزومي» يُجهد «سمايل» في التدريب، وسمايل لا يرحّب أبداً بهذا الاهتمام الزائد.

eps.t: Staking Your Life on Table Tennis Is Revolting
eps.ov: All the teams gather at the prefectural qualifiers, and China gets to play Smile at last.

eps.t: The Only Way to Be Sure You Won't Lose Is to Not Fight
eps.ov: Peco learns a hard lesson from someone he never took seriously enough, and then we finally see how Dragon earned his name.
Dragon's obsession with Smile prompts Akuma to do something rash.

eps.t: You Love This Sport More Than Anyone!!
eps.ov: Five athletes have five very different Christmas Eves, and Peco gets a wake-up call.
Players, coaches, captains, and their families.
Smile, Peco, Dragon, and China begin another prefectural qualifier. Will the results be different this year?
In the third round, Dragon has an unexpected visitor, Sanada questions himself, and Peco scares lots of people in lots of ways.

eps.t: I Thought You Were the Hero!!
eps.ov: Peco and Dragon tackle the question of whether only birds can fly.
